Ankoku Densetsu.name: Ankoku Densetsu
Ankoku Densetsu.summary: Ankoku Densetsu ('Dark Legend') is widely considered to be the follow-up to the PC Engine classic Makyo Densetsu (1988) ('The Legendary Axe').

Salamander.name: Salamander
Salamander.summary: A version for the PC Engine was released on December 6, 1991. Based on the arcade version of Salamander, changes on this port include starting from a pre-defined checkpoint upon death in 1 Player mode, faster enemy animations, and improved music.
